description: Salt-bleached planks creak underfoot. Ropes coil like sleeping snakes. Gulls fight over fish heads at the tideline.
Stalls under sailcloth awnings. The smell hits before the sight does. Coin clinks under bartering voices.
A squat stone tower at the cove's western horn. The lamp above turns slowly, even in daylight. The door at the base is iron-bound.
A slit in the cliff face, hidden behind a curtain of kelp and broken rock. The air tastes of brine and tar. Crates are stacked deeper than the tide should reach.
features: boot prints in the wet sand

description: Thatched roofs lean toward a well at the center. Laundry lines crisscross overhead. Everyone here knows everyone's business, or thinks they do.
features: a notice post thick with old bills

description: A narrow ship rides low in a hidden inlet, her hull painted the black of a moonless tide. No flag flies from the mast. Ropes creak against a silence that feels deliberate.
features: a scraped-off name on the transom
a single lantern swinging below deck
